asked.item: How to return to the old paste-text-to-5-posts version

verdict.reason: The FAQ states the older remix screen is still available and how to reach it.

steps.text: The old version is not deleted; the older "remix" screen is still available.
Click View old remix screen in the left sidebar of the AI Agent, which opens my.blotato.com/remix, where you paste your source text and generate up to 5 posts.
